information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Markham 3x3x3 Series 2023 One day, two competitions! We are running two competitions as part of Markham 3x3x3 Series 2023: [morning](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Markham333Morning2023) and [afternoon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Markham333Afternoon2023). You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** This is a great opportunity to compete in 3x3x3 Cube – the maximum-allowed top-75% of competitors will advance to the second round! ### Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### No Food or Drink Cornerstone Church does **not** allow food or drink inside the gymnasium. Please consume any food or drink outside the venue or off-site. ### Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
